name: Table QR Code Generator & Printing Flow

planSteps.description: Switch role to 'สร้าง QR โต๊ะ (Table QR)' from the role switcher
QR Generator page loads showing Table Count controls, Shop Name, and grid of generated Table QR cards
Change total tables count input to '12'
Grid automatically renders 12 high-resolution QR cards with distinct URLs containing '?table=XX'
Click 'พิมพ์ QR ทั้งหมด (Print All QRs)' button
Print dialog / stylesheet format triggers ready for standee and table placement
